text:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — nightly perf CI failed throughput regression on small-batch profile, ~25% drop vs baseline. Alert from infra-bench at 03:12 UTC. cc @Kari @Maya

infra-bot: [alert] job=nightly-perf-01 metric=throughput drop=25% baseline=220 tok/s now=165 tok/s link: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/nightly-perf-01 :warning:

Kari Nguyen: on it. any suspected commits? last green was commit 8f3a2c1

Maya Li: quick note — PR #4321 landed yesterday (kv-cache refactor). Might be relevant. I saw smaller batch queuing changes there.

Samir Patel: attaching perf snippet from run:
```
RUN: ./bench_runner --profile small-batch --iters 50
RESULT: p50=12.3ms p95=45.9ms throughput=165.4 tok/s
BASE: p50=9.1ms p95=38.0ms throughput=220.1 tok/s
```

Jonah Park: suggests bisecting with nightly job across commits between 8f3a2c1..b9d5e4f. I can spin a bisect instance now.

Kari Nguyen: please pin model to quantized-v2 to rule out model swap? set REDWOOD_MODEL_OVERRIDE=quantized-v2 for job

Maya Li: ran a quick profiler on a canary with kv-cache disabled and the throughput returned to ~215 tok/s — kv-cache changes look suspect. sharing flamegraph link: https://perf.redwood/fg/189

Samir Patel: great find. can we reproduce locally? Maya, can you drop the exact docker run you used?

Maya Li: docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_MODEL_OVERRIDE=quantized-v2 redwood/bench:nightly ./bench_runner --profile small-batch --iters 20 --kv-cache=false

Kari Nguyen: I'll open an emergency rollback PR for the kv-cache tweak and trigger a new nightly. tagging @eng-oncall for sched

eng-oncall: acknowledged. I'll queue the rerun and hold off deploys to prod until we confirm. ETA for rerun: ~18m

Samir Patel: thanks. If rerun is green we can merge rollback and start a proper bisect next week. If not, we'll run the bisect Jonah offered.

Maya Li: FYI added a test that exercises small-batch kv cache path, will open PR after rollback

Kari Nguyen: update: rerun finished — throughput=219 tok/s, p50=9.4ms. rolling back kv-cache change now. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: awesome. leaving follow-ups: (1) bisect to find exact line in PR4321 (Maya+Jonah), (2) add regression test to CI (Maya), (3) postmortem draft (Samir+Kari). I'll create cards.

Jonah Park: I can handle the bisect tomorrow morning, will schedule. :coffee:

infra-bot: incident closed — root cause: kv-cache behavioral change in PR #4321. Tags: perf, rollback
